name: com.thecitationchecker/citation-checker
title: TheCitationChecker — Academic Citation & DOI Verifier
description: Verify academic citations and DOIs across 7 scholarly databases to detect AI hallucinations.

tools.name: verify_doi
tools.description: Check whether a Digital Object Identifier (DOI) resolves to a real scholarly publication across Crossref, OpenAlex, DataCite, PubMed, and Semantic Scholar. Returns canonical title, authors, journal, year, retraction flag, citation count, source links, and formatted citations.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier to verify, e.g. '10.1038/nature14539' or 'https://doi.org/10.1038/nature14539'.

tools.name: verify_citation
tools.description: Audit a single academic citation or reference (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, Vancouver, BibTeX, RIS, DOI, PMID, or arXiv ID) against 7 free scholarly databases (Crossref, OpenAlex, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, DataCite, arXiv/DBLP, OpenLibrary) to detect fabricated AI citations, invalid DOIs, retractions, and metadata mismatches.

citation.description: Single academic citation, BibTeX/RIS entry, or scholarly identifier (DOI, PMID, arXiv ID) to verify.
